actual: The issue workflow classifies every changed backend/services/** file as backend runtime impact even when the module is an isolated offline CLI with no router, lifespan, scheduler, worker, or running-service import. BUG-946 provides fresh-process real CLI evidence and declares service restart noop, but finish remains blocked on backend-main runbook/probes. The classifier must distinguish offline CLI-only modules using authoritative runtime target/catalog evidence, keep real backend changes fail-closed, and must not create an unnecessary restart gate.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
